task: research programme sensing-selfcal (pick_track draw): milestone 3c, delete-one-keyframe jackknife and cluster sandwiches for natural-feature self-calibration on TUM RGB-D

errors.what: First full run.py was started with run_in_background at the default 30-minute limit and wrote results only at the end; it was killed at 45 of 65 windows and ~30 min of compute was lost
errors.fix: run.py now appends each finished window to partial.jsonl and resumes; rerun with a 2-hour timeout

errors.what: A synthetic test assumed a constant per-track pixel offset would show as lag-1 residual correlation after refitting; the refitted 3D point absorbs it (corr -0.09)
errors.fix: test evaluates the statistic at the true parameters; the absorption is noted in LOG

doc_friction.issue: Says to start long jobs with run_in_background but not that the default background limit is 30 min; a 50-min experiment needs an explicit timeout (max 7200000 ms) and incremental output, or it is killed with nothing saved
Did not seed OpenCV's RNG (RANSAC), so an exact re-solve was not guaranteed; in practice all 64 windows reproduced within 0.1%

deviations.why: After the first run was killed, the rerun skipped the jackknife on windows that already fail milestone 3b's counting rules (not scored under the pre-registered rules) to save time
deviations.did: stored those windows' re-solve only, marked 'skipped'
deviations.result: no scored window affected; the same 57 windows count as in milestone 3b
